notes.title: Patch Note 0.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973892/1c2328cea5f24b8fe1c8e3aab0933428f4958810.png[/img]

[b][h2]Steam Demo Festival[/h2][/b]
In February, on the 6th of this year, an update will be released under the number 0.8. Below is a list of changes. This patch is dedicated to the February Demo Festival on Steam.

We also want to inform you that along with the release of the update, public access for the Demo version will open.

[h2][b]ADDED/CHANGED:[/b][/h2]

• Updated version of the engine
• Added support for new version of URP
• Redesigned lighting
• Replaced the character with the final version
• Work has been done on management
• Added new VFX effects
• Fixed some camera triggers
• Added new save checkpoints on levels
• Added a character customization item to the main menu
вЂў Added a stub for the store to the main menu
• Completely redone 1 Biome
• Added 4th level to 1 Biome
• Added option to select game mode
• Adding new puzzles and obstacles
• Animation of the main character with the help of sounds

[h2][b]IN PROGRESS:[/b][/h2]

• Implementation of the controller
• Work on the points system

[b]Add the game to your wishlist if you haven't already :)[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.7b
notes.content:
[b]ADDED/CHANGED:[/b]

 • Updated engine version on Unity 2021.3.9
 • Updated all internal plugin packages
 • Work has been done on color correction of all levels
 • Replaced the main character
 • Redesigned management completely from scratch
 • Minor changes on maps of the 1st Biome
 • Changed camera behavior logic
 • Introductory cut-scenes of levels can be skipped
 • The entire interface has been redesigned and adapted to different screens
 • Added action cameras

[b]IN PROGRESS:[/b]

 • Work is underway to introduce support for Linux and MacOS
 • Work on the points system

[b]ERRORS:[/b]

 • The scoring system is currently disabled
